traditional: 令 A 覺得格格不入
jyutping: ling6 A gok3 dak1 gaak3 gaak3 bat1 jap6

boxes.meaning: make someone feel unable to relate

english.meaning: make someone feel unable to relate
english.note: Use this when something makes a person feel that they cannot fit in or relate to the people around them.

examples.english: That kind of atmosphere can alienate me and make me feel out of place.
examples.traditional: 嗰種氣氛會令我覺得格格不入。
